title: 光的粒子性：光子、光谱与热辐射
source_doc: course/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/03_3. Particle Properties of Light.md
author_source: project/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/03_3. Particle Properties of Light/src.py

points.K5: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学实验室门口，手里托着一个发光的小光球，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of an optics lab holding a small glowing ball of light in one paw and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲光的粒子性。
overlay: 光的粒子性：光子、光谱与热辐射

shots.scene: 光子、原子、彩虹光谱条、发红的铁块四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a tiny glowing dot of light, a simple atom with rings, a rainbow strip with dark lines, and a red-hot iron bar. No people.
shots.narration: 光子、能级、光谱，还有热辐射。

shots.scene: 光谱实验室里，阿杰看着两盏颜色不同的放电灯，一脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: In a spectroscopy lab, the young male student looks curiously at two enclosed discharge lamps glowing in different colors.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：为什么每盏灯颜色都不同？

shots.scene: 小研把一片三棱镜放在灯前，墙上出现几条彩线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a glass prism in front of one lamp, and a few colored lines appear on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研说：秘密藏在光的粒子性里。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这一课，把光看成一份份能量。

shots.scene: 欣欣一手托着水波图标，一手托着一串小光点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a wavy water ripple icon in one paw and a string of tiny glowing dots in the other.
shots.narration: 光既像波，也像一串粒子。

shots.scene: 反射、折射图标贴在波浪旁，发光、吸收图标贴在光点旁
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a mirror reflection and a bent straw in water placed beside a wave; icons of a glowing bulb and a dark absorbing block placed beside a row of dots. No people.
shots.narration: 反射折射靠波，发光吸收靠粒子。

shots.scene: 一串光点像小火车一样连成一列向前跑
shots.prompt_en: A row of tiny glowing dots lined up like a little train running forward. No people.
shots.narration: 今天，我们把光看成一串光子。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four blank cards floating in the air.
shots.narration: 这一课，要弄懂四件事。

shots.scene: 四张卡片依次打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards each getting a green check mark one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 原子、光谱、热辐射、穿过材料。

shots.scene: 一束光被放大，分成一个个小光包
shots.prompt_en: A beam of light zooms in and splits into many small glowing packets. No people.
shots.narration: 光子，是光里最小的一份。

shots.scene: 红、绿、蓝三种颜色的小光包并排
shots.prompt_en: Three small glowing packets side by side, one red, one green and one blue. No people.
shots.narration: 不同颜色，光子也不一样。

shots.scene: 小光包旁边是波浪、尺子、电池三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A glowing packet next to three icons: a wavy line, a ruler and a battery. No people.
shots.narration: 用频率、波长和能量来描述它。

shots.scene: 实心小球图标被打叉，旁边是一小段波浪组成的光包
shots.prompt_en: A solid tiny ball icon crossed out with a red X, next to a short bundle of waves wrapped into a glowing packet. No people.
shots.narration: 它不是小钢珠，更像一小团波。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着红色和紫色两个光包，紫色的更亮更大
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a red glowing packet and a violet glowing packet, the violet one brighter and fuller.
shots.narration: 频率越高，每个光子能量越大。

shots.scene: 一个关系式方框：能量、常数、频率三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A framed box with three icons in a row: a battery, a small fixed weight, and a wave counter. No people.
shots.narration: 能量等于普朗克常数乘频率。

shots.scene: 长波浪和短密波浪对比，短波浪旁有向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: A long lazy wave next to a short tightly packed wave, with an up arrow beside the short wave. No people.
shots.narration: 波长越短，单个光子越有劲。

shots.scene: 从红到紫的色带下方，一排能量柱由低到高
shots.prompt_en: A rainbow strip from red to violet with a row of bars underneath rising from low on the red side to high on the violet side. No people.
shots.narration: 红光最温和，紫光、紫外更强。

shots.section_title: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射
shots.scene: 一束光射向一块透明玻璃板的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a light beam heading toward a clear glass slab. No people.
shots.narration: 光穿过一块材料，会分成几路。
overlay: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射

shots.section_title: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射
shots.scene: 玻璃板前后两个面各有一小股光被反射回来
shots.prompt_en: Small parts of the beam bounce back from both the front face and the back face of the glass slab. No people.
shots.narration: 进出两个表面，各反射一点。

shots.section_title: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射
shots.scene: 玻璃板内部，光线一部分被吸收变暗，一部分向四周散开
shots.prompt_en: Inside the glass slab, part of the beam fades into the material and part sprays out sideways in small rays. No people.
shots.narration: 材料里，一部分被吸收，一部分散射。

shots.section_title: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射
shots.scene: 剩下的细一些的光束从玻璃板后面出去
shots.prompt_en: A thinner beam comes out of the back of the glass slab and continues forward. No people.
shots.narration: 剩下的，才透射出去。

shots.section_title: 光穿过材料：反射、吸收、散射、透射
shots.scene: 示意图中光束越来越窄，旁边一个电池图标电量下降
shots.prompt_en: In the diagram the beam gets narrower step by step, next to a battery icon whose charge drops. No people.
shots.narration: 图里光束变窄，表示能量变少。

shots.scene: 一串光点走进材料，一个个消失
shots.prompt_en: A row of glowing dots enters a block of material and disappears one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收，就是光子被材料吃掉。

shots.scene: 光点越来越少，光束越来越暗
shots.prompt_en: Fewer and fewer glowing dots remain, and the beam becomes dimmer. No people.
shots.narration: 光子少了，光就弱了。

shots.scene: 放大镜对准材料，里面露出许多小原子
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over the block of material reveals many tiny atoms inside. No people.
shots.narration: 要看清吸收，得钻进原子里看。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个大原子模型：中间原子核，外面一圈圈轨道
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a big atom model with a nucleus in the center and several rings around it.
shots.narration: 物质由原子组成。

shots.scene: 原子核标正号，电子标负号，在圈上转动
shots.prompt_en: A nucleus with a plus symbol and small electrons with minus symbols circling on rings. No people.
shots.narration: 原子核带正电，电子在外面绕。

shots.scene: 像洋葱一样的多层圆环，由内向外
shots.prompt_en: Nested rings like layers of an onion, from inner to outer. No people.
shots.narration: 电子分层住，一层叫一个壳层。

shots.scene: 最内层放两个电子，第二层放八个
shots.prompt_en: The innermost ring holds two electrons and the second ring holds eight electrons. No people.
shots.narration: 每层电子数有上限：二、八、十八。

shots.scene: 五层圆环由内向外依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five nested rings light up one by one from the inside out. No people.
shots.narration: 由内向外，五个壳层依次排开。

shots.scene: 电子像座位一样从内圈开始依次坐满
shots.prompt_en: Electrons fill seats on the rings starting from the inner ring outward, like filling seats in a theater. No people.
shots.narration: 从里往外，一层层坐满。

shots.scene: 原子壳层变成一架楼梯，越往上台阶越高
shots.prompt_en: The atom rings turn into a staircase, with higher steps further up. No people.
shots.narration: 每一层，对应一级能量台阶。

shots.scene: 靠近原子核的电子在低台阶，外层电子在高台阶
shots.prompt_en: An electron near the nucleus sits on a low step, and an outer electron sits on a high step. No people.
shots.narration: 离核越远，能量越高。

shots.scene: 电子拿到一个能量包，跳上更高一级台阶
shots.prompt_en: An electron receives a small glowing energy packet and jumps up to a higher step. No people.
shots.narration: 电子得到能量，才能往上跳。

shots.scene: 所有电子都安静地待在最低台阶上
shots.prompt_en: All electrons rest quietly on the lowest steps of the staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 都在最低处，叫基态。

shots.scene: 一个电子吸收能量，跳到高处，周围闪光
shots.prompt_en: One electron absorbs energy and leaps to a high step with a small flash around it. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收能量跳上去，叫激发。

shots.scene: 电子上下跳，每次带走或放出一个小光包
shots.prompt_en: An electron jumps up and down the steps, taking in or releasing one small glowing packet each time. No people.
shots.narration: 上下一跳，就收放一份能量。

shots.scene: 小光包上标着一个整份的标记
shots.prompt_en: A single glowing packet shown as one whole unit, like one coin. No people.
shots.narration: 这一份能量，就是一个光子。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一枚硬币，站在只收特定面额的投币机前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds one coin in front of a vending machine whose slot fits only one coin size.
shots.narration: 跳一级台阶，要刚好那么多能量。

shots.scene: 台阶高度和光包大小正好吻合，电子跳上去
shots.prompt_en: A glowing packet exactly matches the height of a step and the electron jumps up. No people.
shots.narration: 光子能量等于台阶差，才被吸收。

shots.scene: 太大和太小的光包从原子旁边穿过
shots.prompt_en: A too-big glowing packet and a too-small glowing packet pass straight through beside the atom. No people.
shots.narration: 对不上的光子，直接穿过去。

shots.scene: 白光照在材料上，只有某几种颜色被留下
shots.prompt_en: White light shines on a block of material and only a few specific colors get caught inside. No people.
shots.narration: 所以材料只吸收特定颜色的光。

shots.scene: 小研指着一张空白能级图上两级台阶之间的间距
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the gap between two steps on a blank energy level chart.
shots.narration: 能级图上的间距，就是光子的能量。

shots.scene: 能级图上从第一级到第三级画出一个向上的箭头
shots.prompt_en: On the blank energy level chart, an up arrow runs from the first step to the third step. No people.
shots.narration: 一到三级，差约12.09电子伏。

shots.scene: 电子从高台阶落下，放出一个光包
shots.prompt_en: An electron drops down from a high step and releases a glowing packet. No people.
shots.narration: 反过来，电子落下就放出光。

shots.scene: 太阳、星星、闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the sun, stars and a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 天然光源：太阳、恒星、闪电。

shots.scene: 白炽灯、荧光灯管、加热器、激光器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an incandescent bulb, a fluorescent tube, a heater and a laser box with a beam. No people.
shots.narration: 人造光源：灯、加热器、激光器。

shots.scene: 天线、雷达、X 光管图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a radio antenna, a radar dish and an X-ray tube. No people.
shots.narration: 天线、雷达、X光管也都在辐射。

shots.scene: 一块金属慢慢加热，从暗红开始发光
shots.prompt_en: A metal block slowly heats up and starts to glow dark red. No people.
shots.narration: 任何物体都在辐射，热到一定才看得见。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个三棱镜，白光穿过后散成彩虹
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a glass prism; white light passes through it and spreads into a rainbow.
shots.narration: 光源发出的颜色范围，叫光谱。

shots.scene: 灯泡、棱镜和一条完整的彩虹色带
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb, a prism and a complete rainbow strip from red to violet. No people.
shots.narration: 白光散开，是连续的彩带。

shots.scene: 发光的热气体团经棱镜，在黑底上出现几条彩色亮线
shots.prompt_en: A glowing cloud of hot gas shines through a prism, giving a few bright colored lines on a black strip. No people.
shots.narration: 热气体发光，只有几条亮线。

shots.scene: 热气体里的电子从高台阶纷纷落下，每次放出一种颜色
shots.prompt_en: Inside the hot gas, electrons drop down from high steps, each drop releasing one color of light. No people.
shots.narration: 电子落回低处，放出固定颜色。

shots.scene: 白光穿过冷气体团，彩虹带上出现几条黑线
shots.prompt_en: White light passes through a cold gas cloud and a rainbow strip shows a few dark lines. No people.
shots.narration: 白光穿过冷气体，彩带上缺几条。

shots.scene: 冷气体里电子吸收光包向上跳
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cold gas, electrons catch glowing packets and jump up. No people.
shots.narration: 缺的颜色，被电子吸收了。

shots.scene: 发射谱亮线和吸收谱暗线上下对齐，虚线连接
shots.prompt_en: A strip of bright lines on black placed above a rainbow strip with dark lines, dashed lines showing the positions match. No people.
shots.narration: 同一种气体，亮线和暗线位置相同。

shots.scene: 向下箭头配亮光，向上箭头配暗线
shots.prompt_en: A down arrow with a bright flash and an up arrow with a dark gap, side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一个往下放光，一个往上吸光。

shots.scene: 几条不同的谱线图案像条形码一样排列
shots.prompt_en: Several different line spectrum patterns lined up like barcodes. No people.
shots.narration: 每种原子分子，有自己的谱线。

shots.scene: 谱线条形码旁边是一个指纹图标
shots.prompt_en: A spectral barcode pattern next to a fingerprint icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是物质的光谱指纹。

shots.scene: 小研在光谱仪前比对两张空白图谱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two blank spectrum charts in front of a spectrometer, wearing safety glasses.
shots.narration: 比对谱线，就能认出是什么物质。

shots.scene: 原子模型、一本空白书和一个光谱仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an atom model, a blank book and a spectrometer. No people.
shots.narration: 谱线研究，催生了量子理论和光谱学。

shots.scene: 阿杰在本子上画谱线图标，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sketches a line pattern icon in a blank notebook and nods.
shots.narration: 做光电技术，常会用到它。

shots.scene: 一支细玻璃管里的气体在放电中发光
shots.prompt_en: A slim glass tube of gas glowing from an electric discharge, inside a closed lamp housing. No people.
shots.narration: 低压气体放电，能发出线状谱。

shots.scene: 每条亮线对应一个向下的跳跃箭头
shots.prompt_en: Each bright line connected to one downward jump arrow on a staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 一条谱线，对应一种跳跃。

shots.scene: 高高低低的谱线峰，高峰旁是常走的宽路，矮峰旁是少走的小路
shots.prompt_en: A chart of tall and short spectral peaks; a busy wide path beside the tall peak and a quiet narrow path beside the short peak. No people.
shots.narration: 常发生的跳跃，谱线就强。

shots.scene: 电子在台阶上停留，旁边沙漏一快一慢
shots.prompt_en: Electrons waiting on steps, with one fast-running hourglass and one slow hourglass beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 少发生的跳跃，谱线就弱。

shots.scene: 光照向一块固体，能量箭头流进材料
shots.prompt_en: Light shines onto a solid block and energy arrows flow into the material. No people.
shots.narration: 吸收，是光把能量交给材料。

shots.scene: 透过固体的彩带上，有几段宽宽的暗带
shots.prompt_en: A rainbow strip after passing through the solid shows several wide dark bands. No people.
shots.narration: 透过来的光，缺了几段颜色。

shots.scene: 吸收曲线上的几个宽峰被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A simple absorption curve with a few broad humps circled. No people.
shots.narration: 这些被吸走的范围，叫吸收带。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个慢慢变红的电炉丝旁，保持距离
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a safe distance from a stove coil slowly turning red.
shots.narration: 热的物体都会发出辐射。

shots.scene: 温度计图标旁，三条辐射曲线一条比一条高
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon next to three simple hill-shaped curves, each taller than the last. No people.
shots.narration: 温度越高，辐射越多。

shots.scene: 高温曲线的山峰更尖更突出
shots.prompt_en: The hottest curve has a sharper, more pronounced peak. No people.
shots.narration: 峰也越尖，颜色更集中。

shots.scene: 曲线峰顶向紫色一侧移动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An arrow showing the curve peak moving toward the violet side as temperature rises. No people.
shots.narration: 峰值往短波、往紫外方向移。

shots.scene: 金属棒从暗红、橙、黄变到发白
shots.prompt_en: A metal rod changing color from dark red to orange to yellow to bright white. No people.
shots.narration: 金属越烧越热：红、橙、黄、白。

shots.scene: 冷金属旁画着看不见的红外波浪
shots.prompt_en: A cool metal rod with faint invisible wavy lines drawn around it. No people.
shots.narration: 还没发红时，已在放红外线。

shots.scene: 灯丝、碳弧灯、太阳三个图标，从左到右越来越亮
shots.prompt_en: Three icons from left to right getting brighter: a lamp filament, a carbon arc lamp and the sun. No people.
shots.narration: 灯丝约三千开，碳弧灯约四千开。

shots.scene: 太阳图标发出最亮的白光
shots.prompt_en: The sun icon glows with the brightest white light. No people.
shots.narration: 太阳表面约六千开，更热更白。

shots.scene: 夜空中一颗蓝星和一颗红星
shots.prompt_en: A night sky with one blue star and one red star. No people.
shots.narration: 蓝色恒星更热，红色恒星较冷。

shots.scene: 温度计升高，曲线峰顶向左滑
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer rising while the peak of a curve slides to the left. No people.
shots.narration: 温度越高，峰值波长越短。

shots.scene: 跷跷板一头是温度计，一头是波长尺
shots.prompt_en: A seesaw with a thermometer on one end and a wavelength ruler on the other end. No people.
shots.narration: 两者一升一降，乘积不变。

shots.scene: 摄氏度温度计箭头指向绝对温标温度计
shots.prompt_en: An arrow from an ordinary thermometer icon to an absolute temperature thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 计算时，温度要换成开尔文。

shots.scene: 欣欣一边举波浪图标，一边举光点图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a wave icon in one paw and a glowing dot icon in the other.
shots.narration: 吸收、发射、热辐射，靠粒子性。

shots.scene: 反射、折射图标贴在波浪一侧
shots.prompt_en: Icons of reflection and refraction placed on the wave side. No people.
shots.narration: 反射、折射，靠波动性。

shots.scene: 波浪和光点合成一个徽章
shots.prompt_en: A wave icon and a glowing dot icon merge into one badge. No people.
shots.narration: 光，既是波，也是粒子。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现光包和楼梯图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a glowing packet and a staircase.
shots.narration: 光子是一份份能量，颜色定能量。

shots.scene: 电子上跳吸收、下落发光的两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an electron jumping up while catching light, and an electron dropping down while giving off light. No people.
shots.narration: 能量刚好对上才吸收，落下就发光。

shots.scene: 连续谱、亮线谱、暗线谱三条色带和指纹图标
shots.prompt_en: Three strips: a full rainbow, bright lines on black, a rainbow with dark lines, plus a fingerprint icon. No people.
shots.narration: 三种光谱，谱线是物质的指纹。

shots.scene: 由红到白发光的金属棒图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal rod glowing from red to white. No people.
shots.narration: 越热越亮，峰值越往短波移。

shots.scene: 波浪和光点合成的徽章
shots.prompt_en: A badge made of a wave icon and a glowing dot icon. No people.
shots.narration: 归根到底，光有波粒二象性。

shots.scene: 欣欣在光学实验室里托着小光球挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in a tidy optics lab, holding a small glowing ball of light in the other paw.
shots.narration: 第三课到这里，下次再见！
